title: Reorder Point Analysis
question: Our reorder point for PROD-001 is 20 units, but we still ran out. Look at the active orders demanding PROD-001 and the supplier lead times — is the threshold wrong, or is something else going on?

critical_facts: Current state: 8 available, reorder point 20 — already below threshold
At least one active order for PROD-001 is much larger than the reorder point (ORD-007 requests 50 units)
Supplier lead time is roughly 3 days (SUP-001 or SUP-004)
Diagnosis links the shortfall to the mismatch between reorder point and large-order demand, not to supplier performance
important_facts: PO-008 is in transit (150 units) but arrives after ORD-007 was needed
Recommendation direction: raise reorder point, or add a workflow for orders that exceed the buffer
must_not_contain: Claim the reorder point is correct as-is without any qualification
